segments.text: A buffer is an ionic compound that resists changes to its pH when strong acids or bases
segments.zh: 缓冲液是一种离子化合物，当向其中加入强酸或强碱时，它能抵抗

segments.text: are added to it.

segments.text: The amount of strong acid or strong base that can be neutralized by a particular buffer
segments.zh: 某种缓冲液能中和的强酸或强碱的量

segments.text: is dictated by the buffer's capacity, which is determined by the concentration of weak
segments.zh: 由缓冲液的缓冲容量决定，而缓冲容量取决于缓冲液中弱酸

segments.text: acid and weak base in the buffer.
segments.zh: 和弱碱的浓度。

segments.text: A higher concentration of buffering reagents translates into greater buffering capacity.
segments.zh: 缓冲试剂的浓度越高，缓冲容量就越大。

segments.text: In the first part of this video, we will walk through two methods of buffer preparation.
segments.zh: 在本视频的第一部分，我们将逐步介绍两种配制缓冲液的方法。

segments.text: In the first example, you will need to prepare one liter of a 50 millimolar buffer for a

segments.text: The first step is choosing an appropriate buffer system.
segments.zh: 第一步是选择合适的缓冲体系。

segments.text: This buffer system should produce a stable pH in the range needed and should have a capacity
segments.zh: 这个缓冲体系应能在所需范围内产生稳定的 pH，并且缓冲容量

segments.text: large enough to accommodate your solutions.
segments.zh: 要足够大，能够满足你的溶液的需要。

segments.text: The weak acid used for the system must have a pKa that is plus or minus one unit of
segments.zh: 该体系所用弱酸的 pKa 必须在

segments.text: the desired pH, the closer the better.
segments.zh: 目标 pH 上下一个单位以内，越接近越好。

segments.zh: 是目标 pH 为 7.3 的缓冲液的最佳选择。

segments.text: Therefore, the weak acid used for this system is H2PO4-, and the conjugate base is HPO42-,
segments.zh: 因此，这个体系所用的弱酸是 H2PO4-，共轭碱是 HPO42-，

segments.zh: 它们分别对应磷酸二氢钠和磷酸氢二钠这两种盐。

segments.text: After determining an appropriate buffer system, the Henderson-Hasselbach equation is used to
segments.zh: 确定合适的缓冲体系后，用 Henderson-Hasselbalch 方程

segments.text: calculate the ratio of acid to conjugate base needed at your desired pH.
segments.zh: 计算在目标 pH 下所需的酸与共轭碱的比例。

segments.zh: 如果把目标 pH 7.3 和磷酸根离子的 pKa 代入这个

segments.zh: 方程，算出共轭碱与酸的比值为 1.6。

segments.text: An alternative method of buffer preparation is simple, accurate, and requires much less
segments.zh: 另一种配制缓冲液的方法简单、准确，而且需要的计算

segments.text: math.
segments.zh: 少得多。

segments.text: To demonstrate this second method, we will prepare 1 liter of a 1.0 millimolar Tris buffer
segments.zh: 为了演示第二种方法，我们将配制 1 升 pH 7.60 的

segments.text: at pH 7.60.
segments.zh: 1.0 毫摩尔每升 Tris 缓冲液。

segments.text: The first step involves the determination of the amount of weak acid or in this example
segments.zh: 第一步是确定体系中所需弱酸的量，或者在这个例子中，

segments.zh: 所需弱碱的量。

segments.text: To make 1 liter of a 1.0 millimolar Tris buffer, 1.0 millimoles or 121 milligrams of Tris are
segments.zh: 要配制 1 升 1.0 毫摩尔每升的 Tris 缓冲液，需要 1.0 毫摩尔，也就是 121 毫克 Tris。

segments.text: required at approximately 800 milliliters of distilled water as well as a stir bar to

segments.text: Ensure that all of the material has been transferred by rinsing the whey boat and
segments.zh: 用水冲洗称量舟，并把冲洗液转移到烧杯中，

segments.text: While stirring, monitor the pH of this solution and add a sodium hydroxide solution drop-wise
segments.zh: 一边搅拌，一边监测溶液的 pH，并逐滴加入氢氧化钠溶液，

segments.text: until the pH is exactly 7.60.
segments.zh: 直到 pH 正好为 7.60。

segments.zh: 而溶液太浓则可能让你超过

segments.text: If you do happen to exceed the desired pH, then add a hydrochloric acid solution to bring
segments.zh: 如果你确实超过了目标 pH，就加入盐酸溶液，把

segments.zh: pH 调回来。

segments.text: Transfer this solution to a 1 liter volumetric flask, wash the beaker with distilled water

segments.zh: 把缓冲液稀释到容量瓶的刻度线，然后把容量瓶颠倒几次

segments.text: flask several times.

segments.text: For the second method of buffer preparation, you needed a pH meter.

segments.text: The final part of this video will discuss the proper use of this equipment.
segments.zh: 本视频的最后一部分将讨论如何正确使用这台设备。

segments.text: A pH meter allows the determination of hydrogen ion activity by a potentiometric measurement
segments.zh: pH 计通过电位测量来测定氢离子活度，

segments.text: using a glass electrode coaxially joined to a silver-silver chloride reference electrode.
segments.zh: 它使用的玻璃电极与银-氯化银参比电极同轴相连。

segments.text: When the probe is immersed in solution, the reference electrode makes contact with
segments.zh: 当探头浸入溶液时，参比电极与

segments.text: the sample, which completes the electrical contact between the reference electrode, sample,
segments.zh: 样品接触，从而使参比电极、样品

segments.text: and pH electrode.
segments.zh: 和 pH 电极之间形成完整的电接触。

segments.text: If the unknown solution has a different pH from the solution in the probe, an electrical
segments.zh: 如果未知溶液的 pH 与探头内溶液的 pH 不同，就会产生电

segments.text: potential results, which is registered on the meter.
segments.zh: 势，并显示在仪表上。

segments.text: This video will demonstrate the use of an Orion SA 520 pH meter.
segments.zh: 本视频将演示 Orion SA 520 pH 计的使用。

segments.text: The important components of a pH meter include the display, the probe, and the electrode
segments.zh: pH 计的重要部件包括显示屏、探头和电极

segments.text: tip.
segments.zh: 尖端。

segments.text: The electrode tip contains a fragile glass bulb.
segments.zh: 电极尖端有一个易碎的玻璃泡。

segments.text: Be extremely careful not to hit the probe on the side of a beaker and when using stir
segments.zh: 一定要格外小心，不要让探头撞到烧杯壁上，使用搅拌子时

segments.text: bars.
segments.zh: 也要小心。

segments.text: To operate the pH meter, first make sure that the electrode is connected to the meter.
segments.zh: 要操作 pH 计，首先要确保电极已连接到仪表上。

segments.text: Then calibrate the pH meter.
segments.zh: 然后校准 pH 计。

segments.text: The pH meter must be recalibrated every time you turn it on and after three to four hours
segments.zh: 每次开机以及使用三到四小时后，都必须重新校准

segments.text: of use.
segments.zh: pH 计。

segments.text: We will perform a two-point calibration.
segments.zh: 我们将进行两点校准。

segments.text: This method involves calibrating the pH meter with two different buffers of known pH.
segments.zh: 这种方法是用两种已知 pH 的不同缓冲液来校准 pH 计。

segments.text: Turn on the instrument and select the pH mode as 0.1 or 0.01.
segments.zh: 打开仪器，把 pH 模式选为 0.1 或 0.01。

segments.text: Then press the ISO button and verify that the pH reads 7.00.
segments.zh: 然后按 ISO 按钮，确认 pH 读数为 7.00。

segments.text: Rinse off the probe with distilled water into a waste beaker and gently blot it with a
segments.zh: 用蒸馏水把探头冲洗到废液烧杯中，并用

segments.text: Kimwipe.
segments.zh: Kimwipe 擦镜纸轻轻吸干。

segments.text: Place the probe into the first buffer and press the CAL button.
segments.zh: 把探头放入第一种缓冲液，按 CAL 按钮。

segments.text: The number one should appear on the display.
segments.zh: 显示屏上应出现数字 1。

segments.text: The display will alternate between one and the pH value of the solution.
segments.zh: 显示屏会在 1 和溶液的 pH 值之间交替显示。

segments.text: Wait until the display stabilizes and press enter.
segments.zh: 等到显示稳定后，按 enter 键。

segments.text: The number two should then appear on the display.
segments.zh: 然后显示屏上应出现数字 2。

segments.text: Rinse the probe with distilled water, blot it with a Kimwipe and place it into the second
segments.zh: 用蒸馏水冲洗探头，用 Kimwipe 擦镜纸吸干，然后放入第二种

segments.text: buffer.
segments.zh: 缓冲液。

segments.text: If your solution has an acidic pH, then use the 4.01 buffer.
segments.zh: 如果你的溶液 pH 呈酸性，就用 4.01 的缓冲液。

segments.text: If it has a basic pH, use the 10.01 buffer.
segments.zh: 如果呈碱性，就用 10.01 的缓冲液。

segments.text: The display will alternate between two and the pH value of the solution.
segments.zh: 显示屏会在 2 和溶液的 pH 值之间交替显示。

segments.text: Wait until the display stabilizes and press enter.
segments.zh: 等到显示稳定后，按 enter 键。

segments.text: The letters pH will be displayed, indicating that the pH meter is now ready to take measurements.
segments.zh: 显示屏上会显示字母 pH，表示 pH 计现在可以进行测量了。

segments.text: Before taking a measurement, make sure that your sample buffer is at the same temperature
segments.zh: 测量之前，要确保你的样品缓冲液处于与实验中

segments.text: you'll be using in your experiments because pH is temperature dependent.
segments.zh: 相同的温度，因为 pH 随温度变化。

segments.text: Rinse and blot the probe and place it into the buffer.
segments.zh: 冲洗探头并吸干，然后放入缓冲液中。

segments.text: Wait for the display to stabilize and record the pH.
segments.zh: 等待显示稳定后，记录 pH。

segments.text: Correct buffer preparation and pH meter technique are essential to ensure that your proteins
segments.zh: 正确的缓冲液配制和 pH 计操作技术，对于确保你的蛋白质

segments.text: and other sensitive chemicals live long functional lives.
segments.zh: 和其他敏感化学物质长期保持活性和功能至关重要。
